listen_addresses.description: Local addresses and ports to listen on (e.g., '127.0.0.1:53' or '[::1]:53')

max_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed

rate_limit.description: Maximum queries per second per client before throttling

http3.description: Enable or disable HTTP/3 (QUIC) support for DoH

require_dnssec.description: Require DNSSEC validation for responses; reject unsigned results

log_file.description: Path to the log file; empty string to disable file logging

certificates_cache.description: Path to cache file for server certificates (for offline validation)

blocklist_file.description: Path to optional domain blocklist (one domain per line); empty to disable

sources.description: Raw TOML block defining resolver sources (URLs + signatures). Do not modify unless you know the implications.

static_servers.description: List of static resolver entries (e.g., for private or custom resolvers)

name.description: Unique identifier for the static server

is_blocked.description: Mark as blocked (will not be used)

filters.description: List of filtering rules (regex or domain-based)

domains.description: List of domains to match (for domain filters)

forwarding_rules.description: Rules to forward queries for specific domains to particular resolvers

targets.description: List of resolver names or stamps to forward to

public_suffix_list.description: Path to the public suffix list (used for domain normalization); empty to disable

cache_enabled.description: Enable local caching of DNS responses

cache_min_ttl.description: Minimum cache TTL in seconds (respects original TTL if shorter)

cache_temp_failure_ttl.description: Time in seconds to cache negative (NXDOMAIN, etc.) responses

net_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for initial connection to upstream resolvers

net_ipv6_enabled.description: Enable or disable IPv6 connectivity to upstream resolvers

net_tcp_fast_open.description: Enable TCP Fast Open for upstream connections (Linux only)

net_dscp.description: DSCP codepoint to apply to outgoing packets (0=disabled)

proxy_url.description: SOCKS5 or HTTPS proxy URL for outbound connections (e.g., 'socks5://127.0.0.1:9050')

network_security_ecdhe_min_size.description: Minimum ECDHE key size (in bits) for TLS handshakes

network_security_rsa_min_size.description: Minimum RSA key size (in bits) for TLS handshakes

network_security_dh_min_size.description: Minimum DH group size (in bits) for TLS handshakes

network_security_cipher_suites.description: List of allowed TLS cipher suites (leave empty for recommended defaults)

network_security_allow_insecure.description: Allow fallback to older TLS versions (not recommended)

ca_cert_file.description: Path to custom CA certificate file (for private PKI); empty to use system store
